finding.claim: The judge refusals for an unknown id still say 'list them with kmaudit claims list --claims' / 'kmaudit checks list'. With the CLI judge gone, only the judge MCP tool (and the page) reach these lines, and kmaudit's agents have no shell. They should name the claims_list / checks_list tools, the way every other MCP-facing message in this change does.

fixes.change: The no-stored-claim and no-stored-check refusals name the claims_list and checks_list MCP tools instead of CLI commands.
The same no-stored-claim refusal in the checks verbs names the claims_list tool.
